summary: Baker et al. 2021, 10x scRNA-seq of adult brains of wild-type Canton S (B) flies after acute consumption of sucrose or sucrose with cocaine (GEO GSE152495); replaces the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0005515 with fresh VFBseq ids. Sucrose (control) samples only: 4 Samples / 4 Assays (2 sexes x 2 replicates). One Clustering with the authors' 36 clusters (all 8 samples integrated, resolution 0.8) restricted to the 43,824 sucrose cells, from the authors' complete per-cell table in SCEA (E-GEOD-152495.cells.txt): 22 loaded (adult neurotransmitter-class and cell-type terms), 14 held. Summary expression as CPM from the sucrose libraries' GEO matrices (17,448 genes x 43,824 cells).

decisions.decision: Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held).
Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's gene counts.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset.

Narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the tissue-specific FBbt term exact; hold clusters that could only be typed as cell or neuron (or stage-specific versions); load glia under a glial-cell term.
Sucrose (control) samples only (as the old load); the authors' 36 clusters, made with all 8 samples, restricted to the sucrose cells.

Samples: one per GSM (20 pooled brains, one 10x library); adult stage (3-5 days post-eclosion; no FBdv term covers days 3-5 only); adult brain; sex from GEO; Canton S (B), no stock named (not linked).

Per-cell clusters from the authors' complete per-cell table in SCEA's FTP folder (E-GEOD-152495.cells.txt; all 86,223 cells the authors' script's filters keep, every sample equal), typed by the authors' own 'Inferred cell type' (SCEA's standardised label kept as author_scea_label). SCEA's experiment-design download covers only the cells SCEA's own reprocessing kept. A re-run of the authors' script (Seurat 3.2.3 / sctransform 0.3.2, CRAN snapshot 2021-01-15, on a 240 GB VFB server) gave 36 clusters but a different partition (ARI 0.48 against the authors' labels), so it was not used.

Mapping per author type (the calls shared with Mokashi 2021): adult neurotransmitter-class terms ('Central brain ...' to the class; type 2 monoaminergic to adult aminergic neuron); adult CNS glial cell (Glia), astrocyte-like glial cell, Kenyon cell, olfactory projection neuron, optic lobe neuron ('Optic lobe': broad), eye photoreceptor cell; Tachykinin/neuropeptidergic neurons to adult peptidergic neuron (broad, corrected after review). Held: mixed-structure clusters, 'Neuropeptides/cholinergic neurons' and 'GABAergic and monoaminergic neurons' (co-expression not stated), 'Central brain neurons type A' (typeable only as neuron).

Expression from the four sucrose libraries' GEO matrices side by side (combine_matrices.py), as CPM; the features are FlyBase annotation ids from the authors' NCBI GenBank reference (Dmel_CG...), mapped to genes in Chado (update_gene_ids.py features_keyed_by: annotation_id): 17,451 current, 3 merges, 30 dropped.
All mapping.tsv rows reviewed by the curator (mapping.tsv `reviewed`).
